sealed_record.thesis: Backpack's token is being marketed as 'progressive' structure while the actual mechanics, spelled out by Evan_ss6 after direct clarification from the team, give liquid unstaked tokens a claim on nothing at all. Only tokens staked 4+ years get an option to convert into a MAXIMUM of 20% of equity, and unstaking to realise liquidity destroys the conversion right - so the claim and the liquidity are mutually exclusive by construction. At $1.25 with ~62.5% of supply circulating by IPO, buyers are paying a ~$4B valuation pre-IPO-dilution for that option, while the equity entity sits on 37.5% of tokens in reserve unlocking one year after. The market is missing that 2026 comparables (Hyperliquid, Lighter) accrue all value to the token, so BP is being underwritten on a 2024 mental model that its own documents contradict, and the promoters have declined to publish revenue numbers that would let anyone underwrite it properly.
